title: Umlilo Obonwa Uvela Kude
intro: Khawucinge ngentlambo emnyama ebusuku, ukukhanya okukude okukhazimlayo elundini, kunye nomhambi oyedwa ohamba esiya kuloo kukhanya efuna ulwalathiso, aze athunyelwe umsebenzi oza kujongana nobukhosi aze akhulule isizwe esicinezelweyo.
clues: Ndashiywa ndiselusana esifubeni phezu komlambo phantsi kwempefumlelo ka-Allah kumama.
Ndakhulela kwikhaya lomlawuli owayecinezela abantu bakuthi.
Ndabaleka emva kwengxabano ebuhlungu ndaza ndachitha iminyaka eMadyan ndilusa imihlambi ukuze ndiqeshwe.
Ndabona umlilo ecaleni kwentaba, ndabizwa ngelizwi elivela kwintlambo ebusisiweyo.
Ndanikwa imiqondiso emibini emikhulu ezandleni zam: intonga eyaba yinyoka kunye nesandla esakhazimla ngombala omhlophe.
Ndema nomnakwethu phambi komlawuli waseYiputa, kamva ndabona ulwandle luqhekeka phakathi ukuze sisabe.
